## Constraints

### Must

- Strict dark mode boutique streetwear aesthetic (Deep Charcoal, Warm Terracotta, Natural Cream, Vintage Teal)
- Preserve all 85 passing Vitest tests and business logic (Smart Origin Citayam vs Bogor, JIT routing, QRIS unique code)
- Mobile-first conversion: render StickyMobileBuyBar on ProductDetailPage with instant buy & cart triggers
- Ensure all buttons and interactive controls have accessible labels and touch targets >= 44px
- Maintain 3:4/4:5 aspect ratio on product cards for clean streetwear apparel presentation

### Avoid

- Do not use generic light-mode backgrounds or low contrast grey text on dark background
- Do not remove existing data-testid attributes used by Vitest test suites
- Avoid slow or blocking layout shifts during color swatch switches
